SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 老实说，不是末淑先开始的吗？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 老實說，不是末淑先開始的嗎？

SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 不是，爲什麼不說別人只說我啊？

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tunggu, apa aku beneran bakal gitu kalau semuanya duduk diam?!

SCRIPT.FRENCH: Attendez, j’aurais vraiment fait ça si tout le monde était resté assis tranquillement ?!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Why are you picking on my sister?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Come on, let’s just apologize and be done with it.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我们还是互相道歉算了吧

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ayo, minta maaf aja biar cepet selesai.

SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Давайте просто извинимся и покончим с этим.
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Allez, on s’excuse et on passe à autre chose.

SCRIPT.PERSIAN: بیا، فقط عذرخواهی کنیم و کار را تمام کنیم.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ugh, but for what?! What exactly am I apologizing for?!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: いや、だから！何を謝るって言うのよ～
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ugh, tapi minta maaf buat apa?! Aku minta maaf buat apa?!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ugh, mas por quê?! Pelo que eu tô pedindo desculpa?!
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Ох, но за что?! За что именно я должна извиняться?!
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Pff, mais pour quoi ?! Pour quoi exactement je devrais m’excuser ?!
SCRIPT.THAI: อืม แต่ขอโทษเรื่องอะไรล่ะ?! ฉันต้องขอโทษเรื่องอะไรแน่ๆ?!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه، اما واسه چی؟! دقیقا برای چی معذرت میخوام؟!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Um...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あの…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Hum...
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Euh...
SCRIPT.THAI: เอ่อ...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: Um...

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 누구도 잘못한 사람은 없는 것 같은데..
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I don’t think anyone really did anything wrong...

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: じゃあ、謝る順番をじゃんけんで決るのはどう？
